Mr. Sudhanshu Tomar, Adv. for R-2  (in person) and Mr. Digvijay, Adv.
 for R-2 alongwith R-2, through VC.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.03.2023 1.

This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No.527/2015 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Kanjhawala, on the ground of a settlement arrived at between the parties with the facilitation of the Counselling Cell, the Family Court, North West Rohini, Delhi, on 15.02.2017.

entities.text: Family Court, North West Rohini, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. It is stated by the learned counsel for respondent No.2/complainant on behalf of respondent No.2 (who is present through VC) that no further amount is due under the settlement.
Respondent No.2 confirms the same through VC.
Petitioner Nos.1 - 4 are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsel and the IO.
3. Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 got married on 06.05.2006.
No child was born out of the wedlock and due to differences between the parties, the marriage has dissolved vide decree dated 25.10.2017.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.527/2015 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Kanjhawala, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
